---
title: "Try the tools in your browser"
description: >
  The package's five Shiny tools, running in your browser with webR: no R to install.
---

The five Shiny tools of NetSimR run right here, in your browser, with
[webR](https://docs.r-wasm.org/webr/latest/), R compiled to WebAssembly, and
[shinylive](https://posit-dev.github.io/r-shinylive/). Nothing to install, and nothing
leaves your computer: the data you upload and the models you fit stay in the page.

```{=html}
<style>
.netsimr-tools { display: grid; grid-template-columns: repeat(auto-fill, minmax(16rem, 1fr)); gap: 1rem; margin: 1.5rem 0; }
.netsimr-tool { border: 1px solid var(--bs-border-color); border-radius: 0.75rem; padding: 1rem 1.1rem; display: flex; flex-direction: column; gap: 0.5rem; }
.netsimr-tool h3 { font-size: 1.1rem; margin: 0; }
.netsimr-tool p { margin: 0; flex: 1; }
.netsimr-tool a.btn { align-self: flex-start; }
</style>
<div class="netsimr-tools">
  <div class="netsimr-tool">
    <h3>Claims simulator</h3>
    <p>Frequency-severity simulation with Pareto tails, caps and reinsurance layers, with return periods and a report.</p>
    <a class="btn btn-primary" href="../apps/simulator/" target="_blank" rel="noopener">Open the simulator</a>
  </div>
  <div class="netsimr-tool">
    <h3>Distribution fitting</h3>
    <p>Fit claim frequency and severity distributions to your data, compare them and send the fits to the simulator.</p>
    <a class="btn btn-primary" href="../apps/distribution/" target="_blank" rel="noopener">Open the fitting tool</a>
  </div>
  <div class="netsimr-tool">
    <h3>GLM fitting</h3>
    <p>Fit generalised linear models to a CSV file, compare them and download the rating factors.</p>
    <a class="btn btn-primary" href="../apps/glm/" target="_blank" rel="noopener">Open the GLM tool</a>
  </div>
  <div class="netsimr-tool">
    <h3>Claims reserving</h3>
    <p>The chain ladder with Mack's standard errors, Bornhuetter-Ferguson, Cape Cod, the bootstrap and the Munich chain ladder.</p>
    <a class="btn btn-primary" href="../apps/reserving/" target="_blank" rel="noopener">Open the reserving tool</a>
  </div>
  <div class="netsimr-tool">
    <h3>Reinsurance pricing</h3>
    <p>Price an excess of loss layer with the burning cost, a Pareto model and exposure curves, and blend them.</p>
    <a class="btn btn-primary" href="../apps/reinsurance/" target="_blank" rel="noopener">Open the pricing tool</a>
  </div>
</div>
```

## Good to know

- **The first start takes a little while**: the browser downloads R and the packages, a few tens of
  megabytes. Later starts are quicker, as the browser keeps them.
- **It runs on your computer.** Uploaded files are read by the R running in the page and are not
  sent anywhere. Closing the tab ends the session; save the settings of a tool to come back to it.
- **Some things need R on your computer**: the simulator's parallel workers, and the GLM tool's
  database connections, are not available in the browser. Large simulations also run faster in R.
- A recent version of Chrome, Edge, Firefox or Safari is needed.

## In R

The same tools run from R, after installing the package from CRAN or, for the newest version, from
GitHub:

```r
install.packages("NetSimR")
# or: remotes::install_github("NetSimAnalytics/NetSimR")
library(NetSimR)
run_shiny_simulator()
run_shiny_distribution_fitting_tool()
run_shiny_glm_fitting_tool()
run_shiny_reserving_tool()
run_shiny_reinsurance_pricing_tool()
```
